Hela: of Mice & Magic, the wholesome 3D open-world adventure inspired by the breathtaking landscapes of Northern Sweden, is coming in Q4 2026.

Your support gives us the energy to push through the final stage of the development.
We can't wait to welcome you into the world of Hela later this year. 🐭✨

Wishlist Hela: of Mice & Magic on PlayStation®5 and join us on this wholesome adventure!

Fight through one of the most infamous campaigns of the First World War in Gallipoli, the fourth entry in the WW1 Game Series. Experience authentic WW1 battles across coastal ravines, arid deserts, urban battlefields, and the beaches of Gallipoli with historically accurate weapons, uniforms, and intense objective-based combat.
Choose from 10 historical classes, join forces with your squad, and fight alongside up to 50 players with crossplay support. Whether battling online or alongside bot soldiers, every battle brings the brutal reality of the Ottoman Front to life.
